entry.title: a short note about database indexes
entry.content:
I keep coming back to database indexes, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Database indexes shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: rethinking database indexes
entry.content:
Short post: database indexes is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Database indexes shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
